findings.title: Global group manage check accepts view scope
findings.body: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java line 70, canManage() returns hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE). Global manage should require MANAGE only, as per-group canManage(GroupModel) correctly does. Since GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup, adding children and role mapping are guarded by requireManage(), an admin with only VIEW on all-groups can create and modify groups. This is privilege escalation.

findings.title: Group view-member enumeration uses authz IDs instead of group IDs
findings.body: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java line 122, getGroupIdsWithViewPermission iterates findByType(Groups) and calls hasPermission(groupResource.getId()) then adds groupResource.getId(). Authz resource IDs are internal UUIDs while group IDs are stored in resource names (AdminPermissionsSchema creates resources with name=groupId). hasPermission looks up by name via findByName, so lookup with an ID misses and falls back to the all-groups resource, and the returned set contains authz IDs not group IDs. Callers in UsersResource and BruteForceUsersResource expect group IDs for UserModel.GROUPS filtering and counts, so results are wrong or empty. Per-group resources are also created without a type, so findByType misses them entirely.

findings.title: Per-group check ignores all-groups permission when specific resource exists
findings.body: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java line 143, hasPermission only loads the all-groups resource when no per-group resource exists. Once any permission creates a per-group resource for a group, an admin holding only an all-groups MANAGE or VIEW grant is evaluated solely against that per-group resource and denied, even though the all-groups grant should apply. This causes false denials for all-groups admins as soon as specific group permissions exist, and NPEs when the all-groups resource is missing.

findings.title: Per-user check ignores all-users permission when specific resource exists
findings.body: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/UserPermissionsV2.java line 107, hasPermission only falls back to the all-users resource when no per-user resource exists. After a per-user resource is created for a user, a different admin with only an all-users grant is evaluated only against that per-user resource and denied. This breaks OR semantics between all-users and single-user permissions and causes false denials.

findings.title: V2 group management methods throw breaking deletion cleanup
findings.body: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java line 174, setPermissionsEnabled and other GroupPermissionManagement methods throw UnsupportedOperationException. AdminPermissions.registerListener calls management().groups().setPermissionsEnabled(group,false) on GroupRemovedEvent. With V2 active this aborts group deletion with an exception, or if the listener is not registered leaves orphan authz resources with no cleanup path.

findings.title: Existing realms never get Groups resource type and scopes
findings.body: In server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java line 251, init returns early if the admin-permissions client already exists. Scopes and all-resource resources including the new Groups type are only created for brand-new realms. Upgraded realms keep the old client without Groups scopes or all-groups resource, so group checks in V2 deny or hit null resources after upgrade. No migration is provided.

findings.title: Group permission display name not resolved
findings.body: In server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java line 349, getResourceName handles only Users (returning All users or username) and falls through to resource.getDisplayName() for Groups. Group resources are created with name=groupId and no displayName, so permission listings show null or raw UUIDs instead of All groups or the group name.

findings.title: Group listing lost global-view fast path
findings.body: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/GroupsResource.java line 113, getGroups changed from caching canViewGlobal once to filtering with groupsEvaluator.canView for every group, same in GroupResource.getSubGroups. For an admin granted via all-groups permission each per-group check re-evaluates the all-groups policy, turning one evaluation into N evaluations and severely slowing listings with many groups.

findings.title: Test cleanup captures mutable group field
findings.body: In tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/authz/fgap/GroupResourceTypeEvaluationTest.java line 76, onBefore registers cleanup with lambda using topGroup.getId() where topGroup is a mutable field overwritten each test. The lambda reads the ID at cleanup time, not registration time, so earlier cleanups delete the latest ID and leak earlier groups, causing cross-test pollution.
